article.title: The extremism of moderates
article.author: Editor
article.content: As Donald Trump stirs up a fresh Red Scare by branding communism a “mortal threat” to the United States, corporate-backed “moderates” in the Democratic Party have launched their own moral crusade against a surging left flank. The post The extremism of moderates appeared first on MR Online .
